hypotheses.justification: `hm` follows from `hmp : m.Coprime p` together with the variable `[Fact p.Prime]`. That variable is an argument of the theorem because it is instance-implicit and `p` appears in the statement. If `m = 0`, then `Nat.coprime_zero_left : Coprime 0 n ↔ n = 1` (Lean core, Init/Data/Nat/Coprime.lean, a @[simp] lemma) turns `hmp` into `p = 1`, which contradicts `(Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_one`. So `m ≠ 0`, hence `0 < m`. The proof uses `hm` only to build the witnesses `⟨m, hm, hpm, _⟩` passed to `hinj` and `hsurj`. Adding `have hm : 0 < m := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (by rintro rfl; exact (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_one ((Nat.coprime_zero_left p).mp hmp))` at the start lets the rest of the proof go through unchanged. `hm` is not mentioned anywhere else in the statement.
